rationale: FX02 is a Class 1 row/cell flag on fair_value_currency. The raw SOI rows place C$ or EUR immediately before the par amount/shares value, while cost and fair value appear as later numeric columns. Therefore the non-USD unit is not a fair value currency; it is a par amount currency that was carried into fair_value_currency, making the flag a real localized extraction error.
